name: Maneuver Amplifier - Flurry Strike
RelatedDescription: Channels extra energy directly into the leg actuator to improve the ST's mobility, whether using pulleys or walking. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Flurry Strike capability.

61203.name: Improved Movement I · Flurry Strike
61203.SpecificEffects:
ST Movement <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
When launching Flurry Strike or Gusty Strike, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
